content: We have carbon NMR shifts: 168.60, 143.85, 130.30, 22.80, 21.35, 19.20. Aromatic carbons typically appear ~110-160 ppm. Here we have three peaks in that region: 168.60 (likely carbonyl, maybe aromatic carbon attached to carbonyl? but 168 is more like carbonyl C=O), 143.85 (aromatic), 130.30 (aromatic). So aromatic carbons count maybe 2? But need number of aromatic carbons in molecule. Could be more than peaks if symmetry duplicates. Need to infer structure? Use proton NMR maybe. Let's get proton NMR.
